# solidping_status_page (Resource)

A status page. This resource manages the page itself; its content is declared with `solidping_status_page_section`.

-> SolidPing seeds every new page with an empty "Services" section. The provider removes it right after creating the page, so that a page managed with Terraform holds only the sections declared with `solidping_status_page_section`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "solidping_status_page" "public" {
  name           = "Acme status"
  slug           = "acme"
  description    = "Live status of the Acme services"
  history_period = "30d"
  custom_domain  = "status.acme.com"
}

# A page shared with a password.
resource "solidping_status_page" "partners" {
  name       = "Acme partner APIs"
  visibility = "password"
  password   = var.status_page_password
}

variable "status_page_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Title of the page.

### Optional

- `auto_publish` (Boolean) Publish incidents affecting the page's resources automatically. Defaults to `true`.
- `auto_publish_delay_seconds` (Number) Delay before an incident becomes public, in seconds (0 to 86400, default 60). An incident that resolves within this delay is never published.
- `auto_resolve` (String) What an auto-published incident does when it resolves: `always`, `if_untouched` (the default) or `never`.
- `custom_css` (String) Custom stylesheet injected in the public page (64 KB maximum, no `@import`).
- `custom_domain` (String) Hostname the page is served on, e.g. `status.acme.com`. The domain still has to be verified (DNS) in SolidPing.
- `description` (String) Text shown under the title.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the page is served. Defaults to `true`.
- `hide_branding` (Boolean) Hide the SolidPing branding (applies when the organization has the white-label entitlement).
- `history_period` (String) History window: `24h`, `7d`, `30d` or `90d` (the default).
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default status page of the organization.
- `language` (String) Language of the page (e.g. `en`, `fr`).
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Unlock password, required when `visibility` is `password` (6 characters minimum). Never read back from the server.
- `publish_degraded` (Boolean) Also publish degraded incidents automatically. Defaults to `false`.
- `show_availability` (Boolean) Show the availability bars. Defaults to `true`.
- `show_response_time` (Boolean) Show the response-time charts. Defaults to `true`.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly identifier, unique in the organization. Derived from `name` when omitted.
- `visibility` (String) `public` (world-readable, the default), `private` (hidden) or `password` (unlocked with `password`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UID of the status page.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A status page is imported with `org/uid`.
terraform import solidping_status_page.public acme/0190f3a2-7c1d-7e3b-9a55-2f4f8a1b6c7d
```
